task_signatures.correct_strategy: Oncogene weights apply only to gain events; tumor suppressor weights apply only to loss events; regulatory modifiers adjust specific gene contributions per chromosome
task_signatures.wrong_strategy: Applying tumor suppressor weight to a gain chromosome, or treating 'normal copy number' as an exclusion from scoring

task_signatures.correct_strategy: For TS genes on affected chromosomes that contributed 0 in Phase 2 (TS on gain chromosome, direction mismatch), add the TS weight as an independent repressor penalty. For TS genes that already contributed their full weight in Phase 2 (TS on loss chromosome), no additional term is added.
task_signatures.wrong_strategy: Applying the repressor penalty to all TS genes regardless of Phase 2 contribution, or skipping the penalty for TS genes that contributed 0 in Phase 2

failure_modes: applying_weight_in_wrong_direction: oncogene weight on loss chromosome or tumor suppressor weight on gain chromosome
misreading_normal_copy_number: treating it as exclusion from CNV scoring
ignoring_regulatory_modifiers: not adjusting score for repressor/activator overexpression
double_counting_modifier: applying modifier effect more than once
key_principles: Direction matching: only apply a gene's weight when the CNV direction matches the gene's role
Modifier scope: each modifier applies only to the chromosomes and gene types explicitly stated
Show arithmetic: enumerate each term before summing
